getStarted.title: Welcome to QuickRelate, {name}!
getStarted.description: Let's set up your professional workspace in a few seconds.

subscribe.title: Initialize Your Workspace
subscribe.description: Start organizing your WhatsApp communication with a professional workspace. Centralize your team and manage your customers from one place.

join.title: Join an Organization
join.description: I have an invitation code or link from my team.

createOrg.title: Build Your Workspace
createOrg.description: Establish your organization's digital identity. This will be the home for all your team collaboration and customer conversations.
createOrg.slugDescription: Your unique workspace identifier in QuickRelate.
createOrg.slugTaken: This URL is already taken. Try another one.

joinOrg.title: Join Your Team
joinOrg.description: Enter the invitation code provided by your administrator.
joinOrg.help: Your team admin should have sent you an invitation link via email.
joinOrg.noCode: Don't have a code? Ask your team admin for an invite.

addMembers.title: Invite Your Team
addMembers.description: WhatsApp communication is most effective when shared. Invite your team to collaborate on customer inquiries and manage campaigns together.

connectChannel.title: Connect WhatsApp
connectChannel.description: Connect your official WhatsApp Business Account to go live. This enables the shared inbox and allows you to start your first outreach campaign.

addTemplates.title: Activate Productivity
addTemplates.description: Sync your existing WhatsApp templates or explore industry standards to hit the ground running with professional communication.
addTemplates.syncHelp: If you successfully connected your WhatsApp account in the previous step, click below to import your templates.

wizard.finishSuccess: Setup complete! Welcome to your dashboard.
